newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TENNIS-KORDA CONFIRMS DAVIS CUP RETIREMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KORDA CONFIRMS DAVIS CUP RETIREMENT.

text.p: Czech Petr Korda confirmed on Friday that he was no longer available for Davis Cup tennis.
"Next year I will turn 30. For me it's time to leave the team," Korda said after his straight sets win over Belgian qualifier Dick Norman in the quarter-finals of the European Community championship.
"I'm really getting very, very tired after Davis Cup (matches), physically, but more mentally because everybody expects me to bring victory. I was always the key player," he said.
Korda, a Davis Cup stalwart for nine years, originally announced his retirement from the competition after the Czech Republic's 3-2 first round win over India earlier this month.
